description: Evidence-tracked metadata registry. It does not contain executable formulas or replace runtime calculation engines.

constraints: All inputs must be finite numbers
Hours, expenses, contingency and margin must be non-negative
Hourly rate must be greater than zero
Contingency must be at most 100%
Target gross margin must be below 90%
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Contingency applies to labor plus expenses
Gross margin is profit divided by quoted price
Tax, payment fees, scope changes and market-rate validation are excluded

constraints: All inputs must be finite and non-negative
Expenses cannot exceed revenue
Tax reserve must be from 0% through 100%
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Reserve applies to profit after expenses, not gross revenue
Tax reserve is user-selected and not jurisdiction-specific

constraints: Inputs must be finite and non-negative
Markup percentage must not exceed 10,000%
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Markup is a percentage of cost
Gross margin is profit divided by selling price
Tax, fees, overhead and market-price constraints are excluded

constraints: Inputs must be finite and non-negative
Selling price must exceed variable cost per unit
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; exact units may be fractional
calculation.rounding: Whole units are rounded upward with Math.ceil
assumptions: Selling price, variable cost and fixed costs are constant
Fractional units are not treated as sellable
Product mix, capacity, tax, financing and changing costs/prices are excluded

constraints: All inputs must be finite numbers
Initial investment must be greater than zero
Ending value must be non-negative
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Initial investment must be greater than zero; ending value must be non-negative
Simple, non-annualized ROI does not account for cash-flow timing, holding period or future performance

constraints: Opening cash, monthly inflows, monthly outflows and both growth rates must be finite non-negative numbers
Monthly inflow and outflow growth rates must not exceed 100%
Projection period must be exactly 3, 6, 12 or 24 months
calculation.formula: For month t=1..periods: inflow_t=inflows*(1+inflowGrowth/100)^(t-1); outflow_t=outflows*(1+outflowGrowth/100)^(t-1); closingCash_t=openingCash_t+inflow_t-outflow_t; openingCash_(t+1)=closingCash_t; endingCash=closingCash_periods; totalInflows=sum(inflow_t); totalOutflows=sum(outflow_t); netCashChange=endingCash-opening
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Monthly inflows and outflows recur and compound using fixed user-entered growth rates
Growth is compounded from month 1 with exponent t−1
Timing within each month, tax, financing and seasonality are excluded
Negative projected cash balances are retained as scenario outputs

constraints: All four inputs must be finite numbers
Property purchase price must be greater than zero
Monthly scheduled rent, vacancy allowance and annual operating costs must be non-negative
Vacancy allowance must not exceed 100%
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Monthly scheduled rent is annualized by multiplying by 12
Vacancy allowance is applied to potential annual rent
Entered annual operating costs are subtracted from rent after vacancy
Yield is unlevered and uses purchase price as denominator
Financing, acquisition costs, capital expenditure, income tax and appreciation are excluded

constraints: All inputs must be finite numbers
Essential monthly expenses must be greater than zero
Target coverage months must be greater than zero and must not exceed 24
Current emergency savings must be non-negative
calculation.precision: JavaScript Number floating-point; no explicit rounding in calculation core
calculation.rounding: No rounding in core; display formatting is handled by the UI
assumptions: Target fund equals essential monthly expenses multiplied by selected target coverage months
Current savings are compared directly with the target
Remaining gap is floored at zero when current savings meet or exceed the target
Progress is capped at 100 percent
This is an illustrative planning calculation and does not recommend a savings product
